title: Prevent arbitrary code execution via pickle
issue_title: Arbitrary code execution via unsafe unpickling
issue_description: Using pickle.loads on untrusted input allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by supplying a malicious payload with a custom __reduce__ method.
issue_suggestion: Use a safe serialization format like JSON, or cryptographically sign the pickled data and verify the signature before loading.
issue_code:
import hmac, hashlib
# Verify cryptographic signature before pickle.loads, or use json.loads

title: Avoid blocking event loop with synchronous socket operations
description: Fetches a URL synchronously inside an async function.
code:
import asyncio
import requests

async def fetch_api_data(url):
    # Fetch data from external API
    response = requests.get(url)
    return response.json()
issue_title: Synchronous I/O blocks the asyncio event loop
issue_description: requests.get performs synchronous network I/O which blocks the event loop thread, stopping all other concurrent async tasks from running.
issue_suggestion: Use an asynchronous HTTP client like httpx or aiohttp, or run the synchronous call in an executor thread.

title: Fix shared state in custom descriptor
description: A validator descriptor meant to track values per instance.
issue_title: Descriptor stores state on itself instead of instance
issue_description: Storing self.value inside the descriptor instance shares the value across all instances of the owner class, leaking state.
issue_suggestion: Store the value in the instance's __dict__ using a unique key or the descriptor's attribute name.

title: Fix infinite recursion in dynamic attribute lookup
description: Redirects missing attributes to a nested dictionary.
issue_description: Accessing self.data inside __getattribute__ calls __getattribute__ recursively, leading to a RecursionError.
issue_suggestion: Use self.__dict__ or super().__getattribute__ to retrieve the 'data' attribute safely without triggering recursion, or implement __getattr__ instead.

title: Fix race condition in thread-unsafe counter
description: Increments a shared counter concurrently across multiple threads.
issue_description: Reading and writing self.count is not thread-safe. Multiple threads can read the same value before either writes the increment, leading to lost updates.
issue_suggestion: Use a threading.Lock to synchronize access to the counter's state.

title: Prevent memory leak in circular reference cache
description: Caches calculated results for quick retrieval.
issue_description: Storing the cache reference back on the object creates a circular reference cycle which prevents immediate reference-counting cleanup.
issue_suggestion: Use weakref to store a weak reference to the owner cache or avoid storing the cache reference on the object.

title: Fix incorrect exception handler type checking
description: Catches multiple errors in a single block.
issue_description: In Python, writing 'except KeyError, ValueError' treats ValueError as the target name to bind the caught KeyError to, rather than catching both errors.
issue_suggestion: Wrap multiple exceptions in a parenthesized tuple.

title: Fix generators ignoring generator cancellation
description: Performs database cleanup when the generator finishes.
issue_title: Blocking code in generator finally block
issue_description: If a generator is closed prematurely, GeneratorExit is raised inside it. Placing heavy blocking sync operations in the finally block delays generator close.
issue_suggestion: Keep finally blocks minimal or catch GeneratorExit explicitly to perform only lightweight cleanups.

title: Avoid class-level mutable defaults
description: Defines a record schema with custom permissions.
issue_title: Class attribute shares list across instances
issue_description: permissions is defined as a class attribute, so all instances of UserRecord share the exact same permissions list.
issue_suggestion: Define permissions inside the __init__ method as an instance attribute.

title: Fix unsafe string formatting in raw SQL query
description: Executes a query directly on the SQLite database.
issue_title: SQL Injection vulnerability via string formatting
issue_description: Formatting the query string directly allows attackers to append arbitrary SQL commands, leading to SQL Injection.
issue_suggestion: Use parameterized queries to let the database driver safely escape the parameters.
